BiblicalUsage: Garol means harsh, and it appears once, in Proverbs 19:19, where a man of great wrath shall suffer punishment. If you deliver him, you must do it again — the harsh man does not learn from rescue.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the harsh man is his own punishment; his wrath brings the penalty, and rescuing him only sets him up to do it again; I hold that anger must be repented of, not merely rescued from.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
